timestamp_convention: Source calendar preserved; UTC supported by conversion code/provider defaults, historical execution not independently authenticated
terminal_window: exclude if shorter than 168 hours; report coverage
forecast_eligibility: all 168 future targets and broad PP covariates observed; all 168 prior targets and broad covariates observed
training_missing_target: retain NaN; no synthetic target labels
training_missing_inputs: Prophet uses complete observed rows; NeuralProphet trains on complete contiguous episodes of at least 336 hours with shared global parameters/target/time normalization, no gap-crossing samples or imputation; SARIMAX causally forward-fills exogenous gaps for state propagation while leaving missing endog unobserved
future_missing_inputs: exclude the weekly origin; no filling of PP forecast covariates
clipping_sensitivity: only exogenous features, training-derived 1st/99th percentiles; target always original
scaling: StandardScaler fitted only on observed training input rows; same external input scaling for all models; disable additional regressor scaling where supported; NeuralProphet target normalization fitted on training data
frozen_history: refresh with newly observed history at every calendar origin, including skipped weeks; never refit parameters
sarimax_state_refresh: extend filtered state through all intervening calendar hours, retaining missing endog
neuralprophet_context: latest 168 fully observed target hours at eligible origins
neuralprophet_prediction: single raw forecast-origin row, step0 through step167; future y absent/NaN; complete inference context, global normalization and existing bookkeeping episode ID
ewma_skipped_windows: carry bias unchanged; no base forecast/residual available; state/history still refreshes
ewma_residual: mean(original target - base forecast) from completed eligible week; update only after scoring
validation: four weekly origins immediately before training boundary, required complete; if ineligible, report and select last four eligible origins entirely within training before fitting candidates
selection_metric: mean weekly MAE, then pooled RMSE; no test-based tuning
mrmr: descriptive rerun: MIQ, target first, training-only quintile bins with tied edges removed, 5 features; original four-gas subset remains predefined
matrix_status: bounded pilots passed; full proposed matrix retained; roughly 8–27 fit-hours before overhead/retries; phase2 not started

sarimax_optimizer_policy.nonconvergence: record failure after bounded retry; do not count as a converged fit or silently change orders; report matched successful coverage
sarimax_optimizer_policy.cov_type: none; coefficient stability analyzed across fits rather than asserting unavailable standard errors
